name: Commons
summary: Travelers and traders fill the Commons just inside Ironforge's gates. From here, the mountain city's great caverns open before them, and merchants, travelers, and bankers arrive from across the Alliance.

sections.title: The Commercial Hub of the Mountain
sections.body: The Commons greets you just northeast of the Gates of Ironforge. Its market street is cut from mountain stone, with the Alliance Auction House, Stonefire Tavern, and the central bank in the Vault of Ironforge. Broad roads lead to the Great Forge, the Mystic Ward, and the Military Ward. Nearly everyone crossing the city passes its shops.

sections.title: A Crossroads for the Alliance
sections.body: Trade reaches the Commons from across the Eastern Kingdoms. Ironforge's central position and the underground Deeprun Tram to Stormwind bring travelers and merchants through its streets. Adventurers trade goods from across Azeroth, buy weapons at Steelfury's Weapon Emporium, or purchase reagents from Barim. Some gather beneath the inn's warm lanterns before setting out into the snows of Khaz Modan.

faq.q: What makes the Commons so crowded compared to other districts?
faq.answer: The Commons is crowded because the Alliance Auction House, the Vault of Ironforge, and Stonefire Tavern are here. Just inside the main gates, it is an easy place to meet and trade.
The Commons leads to nearly every major district in Ironforge. Southwest lies the city gates, northeast the Great Forge, east the Military Ward, and north the Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What key shops and services are found here?
faq.answer: The Commons has the Auction House and bank, along with the Ironforge Visitor's Center, Steelfury's Weapon Emporium, the Ironforge Armory, Barim's Reagents, and Fizzlespinner's General Goods.
Yes. The Vault of Ironforge, the city's main bank, stands across from the Auction House in the Commons.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the Commons is a busy place to trade. Heroes from Teldrassil, Stormwind, and Gnomeregan come to auction valuable spoils and gather supplies.
As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you can see dwarven hospitality, industry, and commerce thriving deep within a frozen mountain.
